description: A script for reading, parsing, and optionally converting Markdown files into HTML, primarily for rendering network stack documentation stored as Markdown into human-readable format.

methods.name: nth_parent_directory
methods.description: Returns the nth parent directory of a given path.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes contents to a specified file, creating directories if necessary.

methods.name: FormatPage
methods.description: Formats Markdown HTML into a complete HTML page with a title.

methods.name: ProcessDocs
methods.description: Processes a list of Markdown files, converting them to HTML and saving output if specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, parses arguments and initiates document processing.
